# GOV.UK Design System components

Reusable interface parts. Each file carries the full Design System guidance, every coded
example, and the complete Nunjucks macro options for that component.

| Component | Also called | What it is for |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [Accordion](accordion.md) |  | The accordion component lets users show and hide sections of related content on a page |
| [Back link](back-link.md) | return link, back button | Use the back link component to help users go back to the previous page in a multi-page transaction |
| [Breadcrumbs](breadcrumbs.md) | navigation path, cookie crumb | Help users orientate themselves and navigate pages within a hierarchical structure |
| [Button](button.md) |  | Use the button component to help users carry out an action |
| [Character count](character-count.md) | word count | Tell users how many characters or words they can enter into a textarea |
| [Checkboxes](checkboxes.md) | check boxes, tickboxes, tick boxes | Let users select one or more options by using the checkboxes component |
| [Cookie banner](cookie-banner.md) | Cookies banner, consent banner, GDPR banner, tracking banner, analytics banner | Allow users to accept or reject cookies which are not essential to making your service work. |
| [Date input](date-input.md) |  | Use the date input component to help users enter a memorable date |
| [Details](details.md) | reveal, progressive disclosure, hidden text, show and hide, ShowyHideyThing | Make a page easier to scan by letting users reveal more detailed information only if they need it |
| [Error message](error-message.md) | validation message | When there's a validation error, use an error message to explain what went wrong and how to fix it |
| [Error summary](error-summary.md) |  | Use an error summary when there is a validation error |
| [Exit this page](exit-this-page.md) |  | Give users a way to quickly and safely exit a service, website or application. |
| [Feedback](feedback.md) |  | Ask users to give their feedback about your service at any point of the journey |
| [Fieldset](fieldset.md) |  | Use the fieldset component to group related form inputs |
| [File upload](file-upload.md) |  | Help users select and upload a file |
| [GOV.UK footer](footer.md) | privacy notice, accessibility statement, terms and conditions | The footer provides copyright, licensing and other information about your service and department |
| [Generic header](generic-header.md) | Header (generic) | A generic header to help services not on GOV.UK |
| [GOV.UK header](header.md) | GOV.UK masthead | The GOV.UK header shows users that they are on GOV.UK |
| [Inset text](inset-text.md) | highlighted text, callout | Use the inset text component to differentiate a block of text from the content that surrounds it |
| [Language navigation](language-navigation.md) | Language selector, Language switcher | The Language navigation component helps users choose and switch between languages when using a service. |
| [Notification banner](notification-banner.md) | alert, warning, success message, important message, flash message | Use a notification banner to tell the user about something they need to know about, but that’s not directly related to the page content |
| [Pagination](pagination.md) |  | Help users navigate collections of numbered pages like search results |
| [Panel](panel.md) | confirmation box, results box, reference number, application complete, application number, interruption panel | Use the Panel component to display important information in within confirmation and interruption pages |
| [Password input](password-input.md) | pass word, pass phrase | Help users accessibly enter passwords |
| [Phase banner](phase-banner.md) | alpha banner, beta banner, prototype banner, status banner, feedback banner | Use the phase banner component to show users your service is still being worked on |
| [Radios](radios.md) | radio buttons, option buttons | Let users select a single option from a list using the radios component |
| [Select](select.md) | dropdown, list box, combo box, pop-up menu | Help users select an item from a list |
| [Service navigation](service-navigation.md) | Primary navigation | Service navigation helps users understand that they’re using your service and lets them navigate around your service |
| [Skip link](skip-link.md) | Skip navigation link | Use the skip link component to help keyboard-only users skip to the main content on a page |
| [Summary list](summary-list.md) | Summary card | Use the summary list to summarise information, for example, a user’s responses at the end of a form. |
| [Table](table.md) |  | Use the table component to make information easier to compare and scan for users |
| [Tabs](tabs.md) |  | Tabs can be a helpful way of letting users quickly switch between related information |
| [Tag](tag.md) | chip, badge, flag, token | The Tag component indicates the status of something, such as an item on a task list or a phase banner |
| [Task list](task-list.md) |  | The task list component displays all the tasks a user needs to do, and allows users to easily identify which ones are done and which they still need to do. |
| [Text input](text-input.md) | text box, text field, input field, text entry box | Help users enter information with the text input component |
| [Textarea](textarea.md) | multi-line text box, multi-line text field | Help users provide detailed information using the textarea component |
| [Warning text](warning-text.md) | important text, legal text | Use the warning text component when you need to warn users about something important, such as legal consequences of an action, or lack of action, that they might take |
